basic_details.job_title: IRCON Rail Welding Technician Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.job_location: Surat, Gujarat (Mumbai Ahmedabad High Speed Rail -T2 Project)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 35 Years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations apply as per Govt. of India guidelines subject to fulfillment of the requisite qualification, pay & experience criteria.

qualification.details: Minimum three years experience in arc welding and experience in covered arc welding of butt joints on 9mm thick carbon steel sheets without backing strip, in downward or upright position in compliance with ISO 9606-1. Preference may be given to candidates having prior experience in Enclosed Arc (EA) welding or similar specialized welding work in industries such as shipbuilding, shipping, heavy engineering, railways, or other comparable applications. | Candidates should be in sound health and free from color blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed.

salary_details.details: The selected candidate will be paid initial Basic of respective pay scale, Variable DA (presently @55.7%), and Allowances @15% of Basic. No HRA shall be given to Contract Employees on Pay Scale; instead, Bachelor Accommodation shall be provided at Project Sites. Contract Employees shall be granted an annual increment of 3% on Basic Pay based on performance.

selection_process: Selection is conducted through walk-in-interviews. Only such applicants will be interviewed who are eligible as per the eligibility criteria.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria thoroughly before reporting for the walk-in-interview.
Prepare an application typed on A-4 size paper using the official application format attached to the notification.
Affix a self-attested passport size photograph on the application form.
Organize all original documents along with one set of photocopies including experience certificates, DOB proof, caste/EWS certificate, and qualification mark sheets.
Report to the walk-in-interview venue at MAHSR T-2 Project, IRCON International Limited, B-501, Swastik Universal, Surat-395007, Gujarat.
Register at the venue between 09:30 AM and 01:00 PM on 03.11.2026.
Attend the interview starting at 10:00 AM on 03.11.2026.
important_instructions: The contract is for an initial tenure of 2 years, which may be extended further after two years based on performance and project requirement. Contract Employees on pay scale shall execute a service bond of Rs. Five Lakhs for serving the company for an initial period of 2 years and subsequent extended period (if any) up to a maximum of three years. The appointment is co-terminus with the project and will not confer any right to claim absorption in the regular establishment. Candidates must bring original certificates in proof of age, community, educational qualifications, and experience to the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in-interview unless as per rules, though TA/DA/CTA is admissible during service as per regular employee entitlement. Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs. Five Lakhs for self with a premium ceiling of Rs. 8,000/- per annum shall be taken by the employee and reimbursed upon receipt submission.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IRCON Rail Welding (EA) Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by IRCON International Limited under advertisement number C-11/2026 to hire 6 Rail Welding (EA) Technicians on a contract pay scale basis for the Mumbai Ahmedabad High Speed Rail -T2 Project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies, categorized as UR-02, OBC-02, SC-01, and ST-01.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply or register?
faq.answer: Applications are processed through a walk-in-interview. Candidates can register at the venue on 03.11.2026 between 09:30 AM and 01:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Matric + ITI OR Apprenticeship Training + NTC OR NCTVT along with specific arc welding experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on 01.10.2026, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India guidelines.
